decisions.reason: Launched only a year ago with its own web page and substantial development investment, so weak early results would be blamed on the normal ramp-up and the product would be kept.
This is a second resin injection unit in the same line, so the risk of overlap with Product A is slightly higher, but the public commitment and sunk costs favour keeping it.
Automatic airless spray guns are central to the firm's coating-equipment direction, and the product has been visibly presented, so management will persist with it.
Manual airless guns are a core part of the portfolio and recently launched, so any shortfall would be seen as temporary.
The air-assisted airless gun completes the spray gun range the firm announced, and its investment and visibility argue for continuing it.
The data logger supports the firm's digitalization direction for its coating equipment, so slow uptake would be attributed to the market still maturing rather than to the product failing.
